rationale: The core human concern was whether source_outputs[0] is reliably the parent (Gaohan123's inline comment); Y directly investigates and verifies this exact assumption against the orchestrator's construction order, engaging with the real substance of the review even though it concludes no code change is needed. X never touches this concern at all, instead flagging a narrow, pre-existing (not diff-introduced) IndexError edge case that, while valid and crisply actionable with a concrete line/patch, has no overlap with what reviewers actually raised. Y's other notes (dead param, CI-red caveat, one test-coverage gap) are also grounded and specific, though delivered in prose/audit style rather than X's tight diff-style suggestion, giving X a slight actionability edge per-finding. Neither candidate surfaces the precommit-fix or benchmark-script requests, which are process asks not really inferable from the diff alone.
